description: List plannings — which product is booked on which order, how many, when, and how many are started (out) or stopped (returned). Filter by order, product, or reservation window. Booqable: GET /api/4/plannings.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. item,order,order.customer.

product_id.description: Only plannings for this product or bundle (item_id).

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

starts_at_gte.description: Planned start at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

starts_at_lte.description: Planned start at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_gte.description: Planned end at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_lte.description: Planned end at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

name: booqable_list_plannings
title: List plannings
